# ISTD Trichur Chapter (Thrissur Diamond Chapter) — Official AI & LLM Knowledge Index
> Official website: https://istdtrichur.in
> Parent Body: Indian Society for Training & Development (ISTD), New Delhi (Established April 1970)
> Chapter Designation: ISTD Diamond Chapter (Inaugurated 30 March 2026 in Trichur / Thrissur, Kerala, India)

## Organization Summary
The ISTD Trichur Chapter (also known as ISTD Thrissur Chapter / ISTD Diamond Chapter) is the official chapter of the Indian Society for Training & Development (ISTD) serving Trichur (Thrissur) and Central Kerala. Inaugurated on 30 March 2026 at Hotel Pearl Regency, Trichur during ISTD's 55th milestone year, the chapter connects HR professionals, Learning & Development (L&D) leaders, corporate trainers, educators, academic institutions, and student chapters.
